utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Sorting the donated tools by the porch would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools by the porch and keep an eye out for anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start with the bigger items first and sort everything by type as folks arrive. I’ll keep the list organized so we can jump in smoothly at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I'll start with the bigger items first on Sunday. Just point me to the list when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — I’ll swing by the community center and pass along the list once I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — that sounds great. I’ll send over the location details soon so you have everything you need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for the location details and then head over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’m here if you need anything for the repair drive, and I can bring a few tools by too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check what supplies we still need and put together a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Cleo — send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d appreciate a clear list of what’s still needed and when the repair drive is happening. Once I know that, I can plan whether I can help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Eli—it's now on Sunday at the community center. I still need help setting up, greeting people, and keeping the tools organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds manageable. Put me down for keeping the tools organized, and send me the time so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the one — folks are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community center today. If you’ve got anything to spare, that’s the place to take it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’m still checking the list so we don’t miss anything for the repair drive. If we end up short on tools, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Pia — just let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive, and I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll add your name right now. Glad to have you with us!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Quinn. What location are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re starting at the community center first, then heading over to Maple Street after that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—last I heard, it’s still going on, and they’re collecting donations and tools for the fixes. I might’ve missed a change or two, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—do you know which repairs are most urgent, and whether there’s an updated supply list yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure on the urgent ones—I may have missed that update. I can check around and see if there’s a newer supply list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still happy to help. I can take on pickup and drop-off if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Sam. Pickup and drop-off covers a big part of it—thanks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and see what they need, and I’ll let you know as soon as I pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll see you a bit later and help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — I’ll swing by the repair drive and check what they need, then I’ll let you know where you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, it’s still on for this afternoon. I’m just running a few errands now, but I’ll swing by and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I can help spread the word and check if any neighbors have extra tools to bring by. Just tell me where you want people to show up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — let’s have everyone meet at the community center parking lot this afternoon. I’ll be back with the exact spot and any last-minute needs soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t seen the latest list, so I’m not sure. The roof patch sounds right to me, and I’d leave the rest to your update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll go with the roof patch and fill in the rest from the latest update. If I find the list, I’ll let you know the other basics too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I appreciate it. Just let me know if anything else gets added to the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great — I can help spread the word and connect a few people who might be handy. What’s the best way for folks to sign up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s still on for this afternoon. I can help get the word out and point people to the sign-up if they need it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. I’m mostly trying to sort out who’s bringing what and whether we have enough hands for the pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with pickup and drop-off, and I can bring whatever’s still missing. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still happy to help. I can take on pickup and drop-off if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — pickup and drop-off would be a big help. I’ll send over the list when I’ve got it together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll handle pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on everything—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we still need and put together a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo—that’d help a lot. I’m still catching up, so I’ll go with whatever list you put together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m already spreading the word, and I can add your name to the repair drive list too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be great. I’ll keep an eye on the donated tools and let you know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep spreading the word, and if you notice anything off, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: What location are we starting with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re still nailing that down, but I can check what works best around the school schedule and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—just let me know the first location when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what still needs doing for the repair drive? I can help sort and load if you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — I’m still catching up on what’s already covered, but I can help check the supply list and sort things out if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — let’s check the supply list and see what’s still urgent. I can stay and help sort once we know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll be ready whenever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and see what they need, and I’ll let you know as soon as I pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate you keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s the one — I’m heading over with a few tools myself. If you’ve got anything to spare, the community center’s the place to take it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I can drop by later and see what they still need. Mostly little fixes, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, mostly little fixes — things like screws, hand tools, and odds and ends. If you find anything they’re short on, the community center would appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — let’s start with the urgent fixes first when you get here around 2.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, 2 works for me — I’ll be there and we can tackle the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you at 2. I’ll have the urgent fixes ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. A quick list and a clear time would help me most, and I can come by then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — folks are dropping off tools and spare parts by the community center today, and I can bring a wrench and some screws by later if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That helps a lot, Tess. If you can bring them by later, I’ll be there at the community center today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina — just a quick update, the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’m happy to help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Which repairs are we covering?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re focusing on the usual home fixes—small appliance, furniture, and minor bike repairs. If anything else comes up, I’ll help sort it out.
